Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles manufactured between 01/01/19 and 10/11/21

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Protection and switching control unit (1337)

  • Fault: Abnormal absorption of the 12V battery, with possible inability to start the engine, battery warning light and warning message "Battery low, start engine"

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Software error in protection and switching control unit (1337)

• Intervention: Reprogram and update the protection and switching control unit (1337)

  • Procedure: Before reprogramming and updating the protection and switching control unit (1337), check that the 12V battery has not been damaged as a result of sudden discharge and replace it if necessary. Connect a battery charger to the terminals of the 12V battery, then reprogram and update the protection and switching unit (1337) via diagnostics.
    If the product code of the protection and switching unit (1337) is 284B61704R, it is not possible to reprogram the unit and it must be replaced.

  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
